summary: Validator targets plan toolchain-workflow-repair; requires execution-plans child directory and 13 specified artifacts; validates self-hosted contract with slices W0-W6 and TDD intent; requires registry commands plan-ready, terminal-full, and green/terminal per slice; checks authority partitions, resume state, architecture acceptance, fixed baseline 2556ea78f41657e5a740016ff97da0b0614631ea and candidate a2ded39b0f67dcbe5f27acedb56c0bafbd3f3fc5; requires empty authorizations; canonical skill-input receipt must be supplied within plan and pass readiness validation; binds expected delta paths and Git SHA-256 hashes with pre-existing-regression-or-repair-input disposition; requires knowledge preflight ready, freeze non-authorizing, and accepted skill-input-execution plus knowledge-execution-gates; supports initial-plan-ready and authorized-repair-revalidate modes; authorized repair requires implementation-authorized plan, validating repair round-1 state, execution blocked, no authorizations; plan-ready requires valid publication receipt bound to validation receipt; emits pass/fail receipt and optional validator input manifest; failures return exit code 1; ambiguity: required-files set includes plan-state.v1.json although initial listing omits it.
